alex: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands runtime Q&A 90sA0		Thanks for the great questions. Wanted to capture action items and owners here.

rachel: Appreciate it. Biggest asks were: kernel parity timeline, Dedicated canary plan, and what to expect re: caching changes.

vince: Kernel parity: core fused-attn + stable MLP kernels will be feature-complete by EOW. Remaining ops (rotary variants, new layernorm) next sprint.

meera: Important caveat: long-context edgecases still need 2-3 more integration tests. We'll schedule a focused test pass Tues-Wed.

avex (typo lol)

alex: Ha @meera. OK, owners? Who is driving the canary on Dedicated?

vince: I'll own the rollout plan. Canary steps: 1) small pool (10% traffic) with `batch_size_target: 64`, 2) enable `kv_cache_sharing: true`, 3) monitor for `kernel_fallback_rate`. If fallback_rate > 0.5% for 15m we rollback.

meera: Metrics to watch: p50, p95, tokens/sec, kv_miss_ratio, kernel_fallback_rate, and host memory pressure. Also watch `regen_rate` on the tests.

rachel: Product asks that we prepare a one-paragraph customer note explaining improved latency and a potential tiny delta in generation nondeterminism for a week while caches warm. I'll draft it.

alex: infra snippet for canary config?

vince: Here:
``` 
pool: dedicated-canary-1
batch_size_target: 64
kv_cache_sharing: true
max_inflight_requests: 200
fallback_policy: "model-variant"
```
I'll PR that to infra/canaries after runbook signoff.

infra-bot: canary PR opened by vince -> https://git.internal/repo/pulls/1123

meera: Runbook updates: I'll add a kernel-fallback checklist and an automated alert that fires if `kernel_fallback_rate` > 0.2% for 5m. Who owns customer escalations?

rachel: Product will own customer communications & triage; assign me.

alex: Cool. Timeline summary: kernel parity (core ops) by Friday, long-context testing early next week, Dedicated canary mid-next-week, customer note drafted by Rachel before canary.

vince: small thing 			please add `kv_miss_ratio` to the dashboard - it isn't surfaced yet.

meera: noted, adding to runtime dashboard now.

alex: Thanks everyone. If you see anything odd during the canary, post here and tag me. :eyes:
